strategies.name: Golden Trend Rider
strategies.description: This strategy captures sustained upward trends by buying when a faster moving average crosses above a slower one. It is designed to stay invested during persistent advances while using a defined stop to limit downside during sharp reversals.
strategies.entry_rule: Enter a long position when the 20-day SMA crosses above the 100-day SMA and the closing price is above both moving averages.
strategies.exit_rule: Exit when the 20-day SMA crosses below the 100-day SMA or when price declines 8% from the entry price, whichever occurs first.
strategies.reasoning: JPM is trading above both its 50-day and 200-day moving averages, with strong 30-day and 90-day returns indicating a durable uptrend. A medium-speed crossover fits a large-cap financial stock that trends well but can still experience meaningful drawdowns.
